server-contacts.ambiguous: More than one contact's identity number starts with {prefix}: type a few more characters, or the whole number
server-contacts.cardAndFile: Give only one of card and cardFile
server-contacts.cardMissing: Give a card: card (text) or cardFile (a file)
server-contacts.cardOlder: This card (made {made}) is older than the one in the contacts ({kept}) and cannot replace it: ask the other person to export it again
server-contacts.exists: {name} ({id}) is already in the contacts. To replace it with this card, retry with update
server-contacts.existsChanged: {name} ({id}) is already in the contacts. The new card changes: {fields}. To replace it with this card, retry with update
server-contacts.idMismatch: The card's identity number {id} does not match the number you checked: do not import it, check again with the other person
server-contacts.notFound: No contact with this identity number
server-contacts.self: This is this {product}'s own card: you cannot add yourself to the contacts
server-contacts.verify: Check the identity number with the other person face to face or by phone (at least the first {chars} characters): a card proves only that “this was sent by the holder of this key”, not whose key it is
